# Lilies of the Field (Matthew 6:28-29)

## Emotional Focus
Feeling God’s gentle care when we worry about little things.

## Key KJV
“Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin: And yet I say unto you, That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.” (Matthew 6:28-29)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus said to look at the pretty lilies. They don’t work hard or worry, yet God dresses them more beautifully than a king. If He cares for flowers, He will surely care for you.

## Coloring Prompt
Tall white lilies swaying gently in a sunny field with butterflies nearby.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God takes care of the flowers. He will take care of you too.”
